basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.details: Qualification: PhD in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology having expertise in Alloy Design / Melting & Solidification / Powder Metallurgy / Thermo-Mechanical Processing / Phase Transformation / Materials Testing & Characterization / Non-Destructive Evaluation / Coatings for Erosion Resistance and High-Temperature Applications / Ceramics & Composites / Additive Manufacturing of Metals and Alloys; or M.E. / M.Tech. with first division in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology from UGC recognised university with 3 years of research experience in the same areas Experience: 3 years of research experience in the listed areas (for M.E./M.Tech. route) Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the closing date of application submission) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Others or as per Government guidelines | Other conditions: | Open to Indian nationals Applicants sign a declaration to take up duty in the discharge of Government assignment anywhere in India, if and when required | Desirable: | Experience in Modelling and Simulation, AI / ML applications in Metallurgy / Materials Science

salary_details.pay_scale: Stipend Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA as per DRDO Rules

how_to_apply: Fill the application form (in the PDF) in CAPITAL letters and sign it.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the right top corner of the first page.
Clearly indicate the fellowship code no. and subject applied for.
Attach the listed documents in the given order.
Mail the application and documents as a single PDF file (application on the first page) to [email protected].
Application must be received within 21 days from publication of the advertisement on the DRDO website.
Email it on or before 2 December 2026.
important_instructions: Incomplete and unfilled / partially filled applications are liable for rejection without intimation No TA/DA for attending the interview or for joining Monitor https://www.drdo.gov.in for updates/changes Canvassing or malpractice leads to rejection of candidature

content_sections.heading: DMRL Research Associate (RA-01) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.defence_metallurgical_research_laborator: Stipend Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA as per DRDO Rules

PhD in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology with expertise in the listed areas, or M.E./M.Tech. with first division in these disciplines from a UGC recognised university with 3 years of research experience in the listed areas
Maximum 35 years (as on the closing date of application submission)

content_sections.heading: DMRL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. DMRL/HRD/RA/2026/01 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DMRL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PhD in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology having expertise in Alloy Design / Melting & Solidification / Powder Metallurgy / Thermo-Mechanical Processing / Phase Transformation / Materials Testing & Characterization / Non-Destructive Evaluation / Coatings for Erosion Resistance and High-Temperature Applications / Ceramics & Composites / Additive Manufacturing of Metals and Alloys; or M.E. / M.Tech. with first division in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology from UGC recognised university with 3 years of research experience in the same areas Experience: 3 years of research experience in the listed areas (for M.E./M.Tech. route) Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the closing date of application submission) Age relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Others or as per Government guidelines Other conditions: Open to Indian nationals Applicants sign a declaration to take up duty in the discharge of Government assignment anywhere in India, if and when required Desirable: Experience in Modelling and Simulation, AI / ML applications in Metallurgy / Materials Science

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DMRL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Notice states only candidates awarded PhD Degree / Provisional Certificates issued are eligible to apply Govt. employees without NOC at interview will not be allowed to appear unless they apply through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The post is temporary and maximum tenure is 02 (two) years Fellowship confers no right of absorption in DRDO

content_sections.heading: How Will DMRL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on eligibility criteria Interview (physical mode, Hyderabad) Shortlisting for interview based on the eligibility criteria Interview in physical mode only at Hyderabad, date to be intimated later Original certificates and a set of self-attested copies to be produced at interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled and signed application form (in CAPITAL letters) 10th and 12th Certificates and Mark Sheets B.E./B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. certificates and consolidated mark sheets, Certificate of award of Ph D degree (if applicable) Aadhar Card / any other Govt. Photo ID Card and self-attested passport size photograph Experience Certificate, Caste Certificate, NOC from present employer (if applicable) Papers published in Journals/Conferences and any other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Incomplete and unfilled / partially filled applications are liable for rejection without intimation No TA/DA for attending the interview or for joining Monitor https://www.drdo.gov.in for updates/changes Canvassing or malpractice leads to rejection of candidature

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Research Associate (RA-01).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DMRL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 2 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on the closing date of application submission). Relaxation: SC/ST 5 years, OBC 3 years, Others or as per Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipend Rs. 67,000 per month plus HRA as per DRDO Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PhD in Metallurgical Engineering / Materials Science / Materials Engineering / Materials Technology with expertise in the listed areas, or M.E./M.Tech. with first division in these disciplines from a UGC recognised university with 3 years of research experience in the listed areas.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian nationals. Applicants sign a declaration to take up duty in the discharge of Government assignment anywhere in India, if and when required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Notice states only candidates awarded PhD Degree / Provisional Certificates issued are eligible to apply. Govt. employees without NOC at interview will not be allowed to appear unless they apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on eligibility criteria. Interview (physical mode, Hyderabad). Shortlisting for interview based on the eligibility criteria. Interview in physical mode only at Hyderabad, date to be intimated later.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post is temporary and maximum tenure is 02 (two) years. Fellowship confers no right of absorption in DRDO.
